name: PeaZip 解压缩工具
tagline: 开源免费的多格式压缩/解压工具（200+ 格式，无广告）
taglineEn: Free open-source multi-format archiver (200+ formats, no ads)
description: PeaZip 是一款开源免费的压缩/解压软件，支持 7z、zip、tar、gz、bz2、iso 等 200 多种格式的读取与常见格式的压缩，内置 AES-256 加密、分卷、文件校验、批量重命名等实用功能。界面简洁、无广告、无捆绑，可完全替代收费的压缩软件。安装版直接装即可，便携版解压即用。
descriptionEn: PeaZip is a free, open-source compression and extraction tool that reads more than 200 formats including 7z, zip, tar, gz, bz2 and iso, and compresses to common formats. It includes AES-256 encryption, split archives, file verification and batch renaming. The interface is clean, with no ads or bundles, making it a full replacement for paid archivers. Use the installer or the portable build.
author: peazip
